source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the other blood group systems (PDF 92).

blocks.text: Neeche ABO aur Rh ke ilawa doosre bare blood group systems diye gaye hain. Yeh aam taur par blood transfusion mein khoon milane ka masla paida nahi karte.

blocks.caption: Doosre bare blood group systems
rows: K, k, Kpᵃ, Kpᵇ, Jsᵃ, Jsᵇ

blocks.title: Antigen ke naam parhna
blocks.text: Chhote huroof a aur b antigen ke naam ke oopar (superscript) likhe jate hain: Luᵃ ka matlab Lutheran a antigen hai. Kitab Lewis ke doosre antigen ko 'leᵇ' aur Duffy ke teesre ko 'Fy³' chhapti hai; aam naam Leᵇ aur Fy3 hain.

blocks.prompt: ABO aur Rh ke ilawa koi do blood group systems batayein.
blocks.explanation: MNS, Lutheran, Kell, Lewis aur Duffy mein se koi do.

items: Doosre systems: MNS, Lutheran, Kell, Lewis, Duffy; transfusion mein aam taur par masla nahi banate.
